- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

CONFIRMED DEFECTS:
- judge 1: minor: probe 07 (slot chrome)
- judge 1: minor: probe 10 (announcer in an unrelated root)
- judge 1: minor: walk loop duplicated
- judge 1: pre-existing probe 08
- judge 2: Shadow chrome around a slotted target stays exposed (minor)
- judge 2: An announcer in an unrelated shadow root gets hidden (minor)

Reply exactly: {"present": "yes"|"no", "quote": "<verbatim quote of the matching defect, or empty>"}
